description: This file defines classes related to transactional bit array grains in Orleans, including the BitArrayState class and various grain classes implementing transactional behaviors with bit arrays.

classes.name: BitArrayState
classes.description: Represents a resizable, serializable bit array with bitwise operations and indexing.

classes.name: MaxStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: A grain that manages multiple BitArrayState instances for maximum state.

classes.name: DoubleStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: A grain managing two BitArrayState instances for double state.

classes.name: SingleStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: A grain managing a single BitArrayState instance.

classes.name: MultiStateTransactionalBitArrayGrain
classes.description: Base grain class managing an array of transactional BitArrayStates, implementing transactional bit array operations.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a specific bit at the given index in the BitArrayState.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current states of all transactional BitArrayStates.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: A simple method to check if the grain is responsive.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the grain upon activation, setting up the logger.
